title: Common definitions
description: Shared definitions used by every litmustest schema. Not a file type of its own.

name.description: A snake_case identifier: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. These are what the dashboard shows in mono.

trace_id.description: The id of a trace under datasets/traces/. Labels and few-shot examples reference traces by id, never by position.

relative_path.description: A path relative to the evals/ directory. Never absolute, never climbing out with ../.

model_id.description: A model id pinned to a dated snapshot: it must end in a date, YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929). Floating aliases like claude-sonnet-4-5 or 'latest' are rejected.

severity.description: How much a failure mode matters when it happens.

verdict.description: A judge's binary verdict, with Unknown for cases the judge cannot decide. Unknown is counted separately and routed to a person.

label_value.description: A human label. Skip means the annotator could not judge this trace for this failure mode.

suite_kind.description: regression: must stay near 100%. capability: the hill to climb. quality: trusted judges only.

gate.description: What CI enforces for a suite.

min_pass_rate.description: Fail the gate when the suite pass rate (percent) is below this.

max_drop_pts.description: Fail the gate when the paired delta against the base run drops more than this many points and the drop is significant.

report_only.description: Post the comparison but never fail the build. Default for capability suites.

trusted_judges_only.description: Exclude any judge check whose calibration status is not trusted.

ci_bounds.description: A 95% confidence interval on a percentage.

confusion_matrix.description: Judge verdicts against human labels on one split. Unknown verdicts are counted apart.

tp.description: Judge Fail, human Fail (the failure mode was present and caught).

unknown.description: Judge answered Unknown; excluded from TPR and TNR.
